items.title: Construction Companies Simplify Cash Flow with Automated AR Workflows
items.summary: Key Takeaways Blixo runs the whole AR stack in one place: billing, collections, dunning, and cash application. No stitching together three tools that don’t talk to each other. Most teams finish core setup in about three weeks. Data import and mapping usually eat around three days of that. On a 1-to-5 difficulty scale, Blixo lands at a 2. Competing AR suites tend to sit at 3 or 4. End-to-end automation shortens the invoice-to-cash cycle and cuts manual errors, which smooths cash flow for construction firms. Firms still tracking AR by hand tend to carry longer Days Sales Outstanding and more frequent cash gaps. Implementation time across tools ranges from three weeks for a standard setup to five weeks when an ERP sync is involved. Quick Summary What does the comparison table actually tell you?
